name: 黏黏宝
description: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

moves.name: 泡沫
moves.description: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。

moves.name: 酸液炸弹
moves.description: 喷出能溶化对手的液体进行攻击。 大幅降低对手的特防。

moves.name: 溶化
moves.description: 通过细胞的变化进行液化， 从而大幅提高自己的防御。

moves.name: 水之波动
moves.description: 用水的震动攻击对手。 有时会使对手混乱。

moves.name: 龙之波动
moves.description: 从大大的口中 掀起冲击波攻击对手。

moves.name: Shelter
moves.description: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

moves.name: 水炮
moves.description: 向对手猛烈地喷射 大量水流进行攻击。
